needs.premise: One logical key, bounded retries, one GC and one live-parent restoration; atomic ledger/view/scanner and consumer-drain premises. Includes lost registration and ACK histories; no C/multi-key table/liveness proof.
Selective operation laws, guarded root coverage, retained physical scan pin, restored-pin separation, key fence and arithmetic; no complete QNT Step induction/source simulation.

Generated semantic invocation/key sequence, immutable origin specification and request generation; exclude physical FP/SCMOBJ address as identity; legitimate Scheme reinvocation differs from delivery retry.
Per-VM canonical record reserved before effects; matching-key dedup, immutable intent, current revision and lifetime pin; absence with delayed request does not prove no effect.
ACK closes one exact extra origin lease only after canonical root/effect custody; retain physical view pin through readers/borrowers. Never clear natural Scheme slot/map or restored-parent pin.

Reacquire logical frame and current slot after relocation/restoration; distinguish same-live-native invocation from fresh Scheme reinvocation and unwound C activation; continuation/denv writers remain a premise.
Actual selected CFUN lacks cleanup body; outer run/call catcher and native guard must transfer source view/key and close future publication before unwind; dynamic-wind alone is insufficient.
Source ACK, terminal result handoff, incoming delivery/query/scanner drain and persistent retired-key admission fence are distinct; no max-seen shortcut, wrap or recreation after tombstone deletion.
Concrete control-lock/atomic and storage lifetime proof for lookup pin, revision recheck, collector relocation and deferred physical release; no weak-memory/source receipt.

Generator _ptree2/_t-c-1/_t-c-2/_t-c-3 and tracked _kernel.c establish exact selected CFUN shape. Preserve frame/context roots and origin across C value/sop copies; selected generated profile freshness and all raw writers remain open.

Registry close and root acceptance linearize in one domain; frozen complete caller view covers closed-round deferral. Snapshot membership and relocation exclusion cannot be inferred from release/acquire alone.

Separate prepared capacity, stable routing descriptors, bound native children and committed collector members. Current processor_count drives barrier and GC partitioning; changing it needs a real generation transition, not a renamed scalar.
Activation slots fully initialized before registration; source overlap until accepted; marker failure/rethrow funnel after END_TRY; unique marker clear/drop before status.

callers.actualChain: c-lambda source argument aliases mapped CFUN slot; cleanup-body selection depends on parameter conversion needs
callers.hazard: Issue logical native-invocation key and origin token after conversion, before first possible effect
callers.replacement: No key computed from physical stack/value address; arbitrary c-code/direct C callers require explicit origin.

callers.actualChain: No-cleanup CFUN body calls current_vm_resize; OOL returns through resource-specific R_ALL
callers.hazard: Scope/key/source lease progress must survive a bypassed normal C return
callers.replacement: Tracked source shape fs3/link2/map7, not installed binary/profile equivalence.

callers.actualChain: sop result copied back/operation NOOP marked, then processor0 may throw collected error
callers.hazard: Publish canonical registration/lease disposition before caller sees status; original status and logical pending state live outside local sop
callers.replacement: OP_NOOP or absence of normal return is not proof that an effect never happened.

callers.actualChain: call restores local catcher and may rethrow to run; normal inline marker cleanup can be bypassed
callers.hazard: VM escrow accepts frozen source view/key, closes admission, then stable scope exit guard handles every catcher path
callers.replacement: Modified nonvolatile setjmp locals are not sole cleanup/result state; no resurrected dead C activation.

callers.actualChain: GC prepares current PSTATE fp; CFUN_ARG recomputes address; return-to-C validates processor and live marker
callers.hazard: Re-resolve logical FrameSpec/PointId and bind generation before reload; old source-ACK cannot target new frame pin
callers.replacement: Stable Scheme continuation does not guarantee old physical fp or live C stack.

callers.actualChain: Frame/denv writes and continuation-return/graft; same dynamic-wind context goes directly to continue
callers.hazard: Track source lease identity and restore binding; guard every actual resume/use, not only wind hooks
callers.replacement: All writers/serialization/native borrowers remain source obligations; no immutable captured-frame assumption.

callers.actualChain: Main module thunk and worker bootstrap thunk converge on run and marker handling
callers.hazard: Shared activation/root/query/exit protocol, then independent per-child source handoff and consumer drain
callers.replacement: Registration acceptance/ACK is not thread creation, GC member commit or child-stop evidence.

allocators.actualPath: Existing C parameter and local sop do not encode recoverable invocation identity
allocators.contract: Allocate key before publication; insert-or-find one canonical immutable-intent record; duplicate submits reuse it
allocators.failure: Conflicting intent rejects; failed/unknown insertion keeps source view; query absence alone cannot release it
allocators.custodian: Live NativeActivation/source lease until VM record custody is known

allocators.actualPath: Operation may execute before original sop caller gets a normal result
allocators.contract: Pin canonical record, read key/descriptor/revision/status only; ACK later revalidates under same control domain
allocators.failure: No SCMOBJ payload returned as a raw query capability; stale/wrong-key receipt rejects
allocators.custodian: VM owns canonical entry/root and lookup lifetime; caller retains exact old source lease

allocators.actualPath: Natural Scheme frame remains a precise root independent of helper lease
allocators.contract: Logical ACK closes exact extra origin lease once; physical old-view pin waits for its scanner/borrowers
allocators.failure: Never erase arg slot, frame map, still refcount or newer binding pin as a broad ACK cleanup
allocators.custodian: VM descriptor or terminal no-future-effect record owns operation; natural GVM frame retains language roots

allocators.actualPath: Physical fp and dynamic/control extent can change across resume
allocators.contract: Keep old operation/source token separate from restored binding token; reload current generation/epoch before use
allocators.failure: Old receipt settles old lease only; dead native marker cannot be revived
allocators.custodian: Original source backing/VM escrow plus independent restored-parent pin

allocators.actualPath: No-cleanup CFUN can be bypassed by a nonlocal exit to outer catcher
allocators.contract: Before exit, transfer stable view/key, close future publication; pending request cancels, accepted root stays VM owned until drain
allocators.failure: No hidden continuation retry or callback under control lock; unknown root/view write refuses handoff
allocators.custodian: VM canonical escrow, not stack local progress or unwound owner

allocators.actualPath: Runtime statuses, native return and resource stop have separate endpoints
allocators.contract: Keep terminal outcome until delivered/acknowledged; then drain query/scanner/delivery readers and retain anti-replay frontier
allocators.failure: No tombstone free from source ACK alone; delayed attempts cannot recreate a retired key
allocators.custodian: VM record/result acceptor; per-child native custody remains imported RB-MEMBERS duty

orders.orderContract: Key/origin intent and safe empty slots precede insert-or-find; accept-vs-GC-close arbitration is the predecessor shared cut.
orders.rejectedShortcut: No helper effect before key/source view is recoverable; no pointer-address dedup after moving GC.

orders.orderContract: Lookup and lifetime pin precede reading record; copied receipt names key/generation/revision only; unpin may follow.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Receipt is not a raw pointer lease or a load of current Scheme value. ACK must resolve and recheck again.

orders.orderContract: Revalidate canonical identity/root-or-terminal custody and old borrower stop, then one logical lease ACK.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Physical pin release is deferred while source scan readers exist, even if the descriptor is already accepted.

orders.orderContract: Frame restore closes old raw borrow; fresh binding/map/epoch is acquired before new use; old ACK touches only old lease.
orders.rejectedShortcut: No old C stack frame pointer/loaded value/catcher/token reused as new-generation authority.

orders.orderContract: Stable VM ownership and publication-close record precede physical source exit; cleanup state is outside indeterminate locals.
orders.rejectedShortcut: No callback/wind hook or normal-only CFUN AT_END assumed to run on every exception/continuation edge.

orders.orderContract: Terminal status handoff, source lease settlement, old scanner/query/delivery drain and persistent retired-key gate precede metadata free.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Max observed request sequence is not a contiguous retired prefix; no fence reset or ID wrap while stale producers remain.

costs.addedCost: Key/intent comparison, status/revision and O(R) work for R deliveries
costs.condition: No claim R native retries already occur; this eliminates support needed by a correct recoverable path.

costs.bound: 0 natural Scheme slots or GC-map entries removed; one old lease ACK at most once
costs.addedCost: Old view pin may outlive ACK until scanner/raw borrowers drain
costs.condition: No GC scan saving claimed for natural Scheme frame; separate pin retention may shrink only after its own gate.

costs.removedWork: Keep same live request through pause rather than repeat native effect
costs.bound: Old source lease0 and restored-parent pin1 are independent; query reload does not re-evaluate Scheme arguments
costs.condition: Legitimate fresh Scheme invocation needs a fresh key; old unwound C activation remains invalid.

costs.removedWork: Recover status without materializing a Scheme thunk copy
costs.bound: 0 Scheme payload loads/evaluations by the control-only query design
costs.addedCost: Lookup lifetime pin and current-revision recheck; may retry under mutation
costs.condition: Not a latency bound; lock contention and allocator/table behavior remain unmeasured.

costs.removedWork: Reuse frozen mapped source while insertion waits

costs.addedCost: Source-view/native metadata retained across close; descriptor accepted only after current reload
costs.condition: Inherited full-view/close C implementation and complete writer census must be admitted.

costs.removedWork: Do not confuse root ACK with status/result acceptance
costs.bound: Source ACK plus result ACK plus producer/read drain required before purge
costs.addedCost: Result/tombstone metadata retained after value lease closes
costs.condition: Unknown status delivery or producer history has no bounded total retention theorem.

costs.removedWork: Prevent old key recreation after record deletion
costs.bound: One-key fence remains after tombstone free; duplicate effect count stays1
costs.addedCost: Persistent within-VM retired prefix/sparse holes or equivalent generation table
costs.condition: Full multi-key frontier/holes/wrap proof remains open; not disk crash durability or timeout-based deletion.

costs.removedWork: Count unique backing across source, descriptor, result and restored parent
costs.bound: P=max_t(B_unique + H_active + H_tombstones + V_old + V_new + Q_pins + Fence + Native_unique)
costs.addedCost: Unknown ownership/delivery can extend overlap; value-cell bytes alone do not determine peak
costs.condition: Disjoint classes only; budget L caps L*H metadata only if admission gates preserve waiting source roots; no whole-runtime bound.

costs.removedWork: One generated origin/guard/key protocol shared by Scheme and native runtime consumers
costs.bound: Retire raw sop thunk ownership and normal-only cleanup assumptions only after all consuming paths migrate
costs.addedCost: Typed metadata, canonical service and generated FrameSpec/PointId/effect contracts
costs.condition: Zig would still require the same root/query/ACK/restore semantics; no extra Zig net benefit proved here.
